fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Draven''' catches a ''{{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}}'', kills a non-champion, or destroys a {{tip|turret}}, he gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Adoration''.
fields.description2: When '''Draven''' kills an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he consumes all of his ''Adoration'' stacks and gains {{g|25 + (2{{times}}stacks) '''bonus''' gold}}.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
